title: URBANFEEL: A COMPREHENSIVE BENCHMARK FOR TEMPORAL AND PERCEPTUAL UNDERSTANDING OF CITY SCENES THROUGH HUMAN PERSPECTIVE

bias_targets.methodology: A 'city identity intervention' experiment where hypothetical city names (e.g., Paris, Cape Town) from the Global North and Global South are assigned to identical street-view images to measure whether models alter their subjective environmental judgments (e.g., beauty, wealth, safety) based on geographic stereotypes.

Comparing model performance and perceptual evaluations across single-view and panoramic street-view images to identify biases stemming from perspective data imbalance and geometric distortions in the models' training data.
